messages:
Maria: FYI sales intake — Zenith Energy asking for private VPC / on‑prem pilot. Main asks: HSM/KMS with export disabled, air‑gapped option for model updates, strict data residency. Timeline request: pilot in ~8 weeks. Can we triage feasibility?
Evan: pasted customer note: "Must be deployable inside their data center, FIPS/HSM required, dedicated IPs, private S3 endpoints, token-level audit logs. Pilot scope: 1 model, ~10 qps avg, burst 40 qps."
Zoe: ok first question — model size & whether they're ok with quantized variants. That affects GPU and timeline a lot. Evan, did they specify model family?
Evan: they said "open-source Llama-derived, ~30B" but open to smaller if quality holds. Also asked about us managing model updates vs customer pushing weights.
Sam: infra notes: blockers = network peering/circuit install (if on‑prem), terraform bootstrap for agent, GPU availability, private registry access. If fully on‑prem + airgap, we need a one‑time image transfer process and signed manifests. Spike needed to estimate 6–10 wks depending on procurement.
Anya: security checklist items off the top: HSM integration (no key export), KMS policies, audit log retention + tamper-evidence, vulnerability scanning on images, and contractual SLA for incident response. Also need to confirm regulatory standard (ISO27001 / NIST / local energy regs).
Maria: Proposed launch criteria for pilot: 1) Model serving with <200ms p95 for target workload, 2) end‑to‑end audit logs to customer's SIEM, 3) KMS/HSM integrated with export-disabled keys, 4) runbook for patching and rollback, 5) documented network diagram and certs in place. Priority: P2 (sales pushing but not blocker for Q).
Evan: customers also want a cost estimate and a list of blocking dependencies for procurement. I can nudge them on whether they'd accept Redwood Dedicated (private tenant) as faster alternative.
Zoe: If they accept Dedicated we can omit airgap + image transfer heavy lift — reduces timeline ~3–4 wk. But audit log / HSM still required.
Sam: quick config snippet we might need to show customer for VPC peering routing:
```
# example: allowed CIDR from customer
customer_cidr = "10.100.0.0/16"
redwood_subnet = "172.20.5.0/24"
# route via onprem-router with BGP
```
Sam: Other infra action items: confirm GPU type (A10G vs A100), decide on model quantization path, and estimate work for private S3 endpoint plumbing. I'll run a 3 day spike next Wed and post results.
Anya: Security action items: drop me the customer's compliance docs + required retention period. I'll review HSM options (Cloud HSM vs customer HSM) and list policy changes.
Maria: Action list summary: (1) Sam & Anya — infra/security blockers + rough ETA by EOD Fri. (2) Zoe — draft pilot scope & runbook (customer-facing) by Tue. (3) Evan — confirm whether customer will consider Dedicated fallback and get procurement timeline. (4) Maria — coordinate internal budget ask.
deploy-bot: Intake ticket created — #INTAKE-2187. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/browse/INTAKE-2187
Evan: I'll follow up with customer today re: Dedicated fallback.
Anya: one more requirement they just added: HSM must support key creation for signing model artifacts. Add to ticket.
Sam: noted. I'll include model artifact signing in spike.
Maria: please post 1-line daily updates here until we close intake. :thumbsup:
Zoe: will do. Thanks team.
